notes.title: Patch 1 released!
notes.content:
Hello!

Patch 1 is here, and it addresses a few of the problems brought up by members of the community.

Fixes:
[list]

[*]Music and sound settings are now respected even if you go back to the title screen after setting them.

[*]Vending machines in Adventure Mode now generally spawn a bit lower on the map

[*]Climbing a mushroom no longer shows the jetpack animation/plays the jetpack sound

[*]Made the Ascension challenge a little harder
[/list]

That's it for now! Enjoy the game, and if you have any problems feel free to let me know either on the forums or on twitter (@ttl_anderson)

-Taylor
